title: Shifting the Spotlight: Focus & Inversion
grammar: Preverb-verb inversion under focus and negation
goal: I can invert preverbs (meg-, el-, ki-, be-, rá-) when another constituent occupies the focus slot.
I can apply preverb separation accurately after 'nem' and 'sem'.
I can contrast neutral narrative events with focused explanations.
